subject: calculus
covers: Single-variable calculus (Calculus I and II), then the start of multivariable calculus: vectors in space, functions of several variables, partial derivatives, and double integrals.

packs.title: Limits
packs.brief: What a limit is and how to find one: one-sided, infinite and limits at infinity, limit laws, the squeeze theorem, and continuity with the intermediate value theorem. Stops before derivatives.

concepts.name: Limits at infinity and horizontal asymptotes

packs.title: Derivatives
packs.brief: The derivative as a rate of change and a slope, its limit definition, the rules for finding it, and reading f′ from a graph. Stops before implicit differentiation and applications.

packs.title: More differentiation
packs.brief: Implicit and logarithmic differentiation, higher-order derivatives, derivatives of inverse functions and inverse trigonometric functions, and linear approximation. Stops before using derivatives to analyze graphs.

packs.title: Applications of derivatives
packs.brief: Using derivatives to analyze and solve problems: the mean value theorem, increasing and decreasing behavior, concavity, extreme values, optimization, related rates, L'Hôpital's rule, and Newton's method. Stops before integration.

packs.title: Antiderivatives and the definite integral
packs.brief: Antiderivatives and indefinite integrals, Riemann sums as limits of approximations, the definite integral, and the fundamental theorem of calculus. Stops before integration techniques.

concepts.name: Indefinite integral and the constant of integration

packs.title: Substitution and integration by parts
packs.brief: The substitution rule for indefinite and definite integrals, integration by parts, and tabular integration by parts. Stops before the less common techniques.

packs.title: Advanced integration techniques
packs.brief: Partial fractions, trigonometric integrals and trigonometric substitution, improper integrals, and numerical integration by the trapezoid and Simpson's rules. Stops before the applications of integrals.

packs.title: Applications of integration
packs.brief: Using definite integrals to find areas between curves, volumes by disks, washers and shells, arc length, and the average value of a function. Stops before parametric and polar curves.

packs.title: Sequences and series
packs.brief: Sequences and their limits, infinite series and their partial sums, geometric series, telescoping series, and the nth-term test. Stops before tests for convergence.

packs.title: Convergence tests for series
packs.brief: The integral, comparison, limit comparison, ratio and alternating series tests, and absolute versus conditional convergence. Stops before power series.

packs.title: Power and Taylor series
packs.brief: Power series and their radius of convergence, Taylor and Maclaurin series, Taylor's theorem with error bounds, and common Maclaurin series. Stops before parametric curves.

packs.title: Parametric and polar curves
packs.brief: Curves given by parametric equations and by polar coordinates, with their tangents, areas and arc lengths. Stops before vectors.

concepts.name: Tangents and arc length of parametric curves
Tangents and area in polar coordinates

packs.title: Vectors in space
packs.brief: Vectors in three dimensions, their dot and cross products, and lines and planes in space. Stops before vector-valued functions.

packs.title: Vector-valued functions
packs.brief: Functions whose outputs are vectors, with their derivatives as velocity and acceleration, unit tangent and normal vectors, and arc length of space curves. Stops before functions of several variables.

concepts.name: Arc length of a space curve

packs.title: Functions of several variables
packs.brief: Functions of two or more variables, their graphs and level curves, and their limits and continuity. Stops before partial derivatives.

concepts.name: Limits of functions of several variables
Continuity of functions of several variables

packs.title: Partial derivatives
packs.brief: Partial derivatives and what they measure, higher-order partials and Clairaut's theorem, the chain rule for several variables, and tangent planes. Stops before directional derivatives.

packs.title: Gradient and optimization
packs.brief: Directional derivatives, the gradient vector, critical points of functions of two variables, and Lagrange multipliers for constrained extremes. Stops before multiple integrals.

concepts.name: Critical points of functions of two variables

packs.title: Double integrals
packs.brief: Double integrals over rectangles and general regions, iterated integrals and Fubini's theorem, and double integrals in polar coordinates. Stops before change of variables and triple integrals.
